concerns.text: FR-008 mandates a custom PyTorch training loop avoiding libraries like `stable-baselines3`, but the Methodology Sketch (section 'Methodology sketch') proposes using `stable-baselines3` for the CPU‑optimized RL loop, creating a direct contradiction about allowed implementation tools.

FR-001, FR-002, FR-003, etc. reference user stories as 'US-1', 'US-2', 'US-3', yet the document only defines 'User Story 1', 'User Story 2', and 'User Story 3' without corresponding IDs. These cross‑references cannot be resolved, breaking traceability.
